facts.text: Evan shared that he has been trying new healthy snacks, including energy balls and cookies, and plans to send the recipes.

evidence.quote: I’ve got to share some of these new healthy snacks I’ve been trying.
You also need to try these cookies, they are awesome! I’ll send you the recipes.
Check out this cool recipe I discovered for these energy balls.

facts.text: Sam expressed appreciation for the healthy snacks and suggested they could be suitable for post-accident recovery.

evidence.quote: They look healthy and delicious! Perfect for after a hike or, I guess, post-accident recovery, huh?

facts.text: Evan described the healthy snacks as being packed with nutrients and easy to make.

evidence.quote: They’re packed with nutrients and really easy to make.
